cases.name: 1. a well-behaved plugin receives real run events
2. a plugin cannot read the task — events are hash-only
3. a plugin cannot read the output either
4. a middleware-shaped plugin is refused at load
5. a plugin never enters the middleware chain
6. a plugin that raises on every event cannot fail the run
7. a sabotaging plugin cannot starve the next one
8. a sabotaging plugin cannot displace the audit record
cases.detail: plugins subscribe after audit, and the bus isolates each dispatch

cases.name: 9. a non-subscriber is refused at load, by shape
10. nothing loads that the config did not name
11. an unimportable plugin fails loudly rather than being skipped
cases.detail: a silently-skipped exporter would look like it was running

cases.name: 12. no second, dead mounting path — a plugin is a subscriber or nothing
cases.detail: a factory registry that mounts nothing is worse than no API at all

cases.name: 13. a module claiming the input gate's slot is refused at composition
cases.detail: displacing a security gate must fail at startup, not at run time
